title: Consolidate Semio Go Into Main Files
description: Consolidate semio/go into main.go and main_test.go only; merge kit_sqlite into main; fold semio_benchmark into main_test as benchmarks; update references; run go test.
summary: Consolidated semio/go into two files: merged semio.go + kit_sqlite.go into main.go (single package semio, merged imports, SQLite region and repo links point at main.go); merged semio_test.go + former semio_benchmark scenarios into main_test.go as standard func Benchmark*(b *testing.B) plus helpers; removed semio.go, kit_sqlite.go, semio_benchmark.go, semio_test.go. Updated bundle README Summary. go test ./... and sample bench pass.
